body:
Addressed: the conflict with `main`. The PR has no review yet, so there are no review findings. The new head is `17b2d962e22918cf24d676f0ddbbdbf75b9f6176`.

## What changed

- The branch took `git merge upstream/main` (main at `39298012074799bf84677c63dc3d34200af8326c`). It is a merge commit. There is no rebase and no force-push.
- One file had a conflict: `crates/post/tests/script_goldens/script_heidenhain_klartext.rs`.
  - Main added the module `klartext/cycle_tests.rs` to the flat file (#4227).
  - This PR moved that file into the `script_goldens` suite and changed the `#[path]` lines to `../klartext/...`.
  - The two sides are kept. The new module is declared as `#[path = "../klartext/cycle_tests.rs"] mod cycle_tests;`.
- `git show --remerge-diff 17b2d962e` shows only that hunk (2 lines added, 6 conflict lines removed). The class is DELTA.
- Git applied the other edits of main to the moved files without a conflict (`script_heidenhain.rs`, and the `xtask` files).

## Evidence, on the final head

- Pin: the 6 tests of `cycle_tests.rs` are in the suite. `cargo test -p camcraft-post --test script_goldens -- --list` lists 6 names with `cycle_tests::`. The source file has 6 `#[test]`.
- Mutation: I changed the path back to `klartext/cycle_tests.rs`. `cargo check --tests -p camcraft-post` was red (`couldn't find file crates/post/tests/script_goldens/klartext/cycle_tests.rs`). I restored the line. The check was green, and the tree was clean.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 31 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled.
  - post: build, lib and the 9 suites.
  - sim: build and the 8 suites.
  - app: `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`, `catalog_groove_part_off`, `continuous_4axis_part`, `first_4axis_part`, `first_part_programs`, `first_router_part`, `tilt_basis_compat`.
  - `xtask` unit tests.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-sim --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run`: 0 steps.
- Goldens moved: none. The merge brought `recorded/golden/heidenhain-klartext/picomax_cycles.nc` from main without a change.

## Not exercised

- The light lane was not run again for this merge.
- Windows and Linux were not built.

The PR stays a draft. Please review the new head.
